通用字节流仪器通信接口
device_entry.description: 这是一个非实体的软件通信组件，用于通过 TCP/IP 套接字与实验设备建立直接连接。它负责连接指定 IP 与端口，并处理命令写入、数据读取、查询收发，以及编码和读写终止符管理，常用于网络接口仪器的基础通信。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component for direct TCP/IP socket communication with laboratory devices. It opens a connection to a specified IP address and port and handles command writing, data reading, request-response queries, as well as encoding and read/write termination management for network-connected instruments.

schema.description: 初始化套接字连接到指定的 IP 地址和端口。
schema.description_en: Initialize the socket connection to the specified IP address and port.

schema.description: 向远程设备写入数据或命令。
schema.description_en: Write data or commands to the remote device.
Read data from the remote device.

schema.description: 向远程设备发送查询并读取返回结果。
schema.description_en: Send a query to the remote device and read back the response.
